lines.en: Moonlight traces the edges of me
I walk over the frost

lines.zh: 我的影子有三个人那么长
lines.en: My shadow is three people long
Every step bows the grass down
I walk around your house
The path between the fields is quiet
No hurry, the night is long
I came over the ridge
The autumn wind follows me
I stop at your doorway

lines.zh: 月亮升到最高时，我就到
lines.en: When the moon is highest, I arrive
My steps land like stones in water
I stand in the moonlight, waiting
I come out only on this night
My face is many faces
Wind passes through me and leaves frost
I am counting your offerings
You are not ready yet
The moon watches the two of us
I say nothing, I only wait
My fingers are long and can count
The fields are harvested, so it is my turn
My breath has no warmth
I stand, and the night turns cold

lines.zh: 屋里的灯还亮着，我等它灭
lines.en: The lamp is still lit, I wait for it to die

lines.zh: 月亮的圆是给你们的期限
lines.en: The moon's roundness is your deadline

lines.zh: 我要的东西，你带来了吗
lines.en: Have you brought what I asked
Look up at me, do not bow
You will remember my face a long while
Place the offering right and you live
Place it wrong and we play all night

lines.zh: 月亮看着，它不许你撒谎
lines.en: The moon watches, and it forbids lies
Your hands shake, I do not mind

lines.zh: 我数过了，你只带了一件
lines.en: I counted, you brought only one

lines.zh: 直视我很不容易，我知道
lines.en: Meeting my eyes is hard, I know

lines.zh: 你身后的人脸是我放的
lines.en: Those faces behind you are mine
Do not try to run, the night is not over
I am hungry, but I will not eat you
I want little, only one thing
Your heartbeat sounds like a drum

lines.zh: 月亮在往上走，时间在少
lines.en: The moon climbs, the time drains
Which did you choose, let me see
Do not turn your face away from me

lines.zh: 我们之间只隔一件正确的东西
lines.en: Only one correct thing stands between us
The moon in your eyes is shaking

lines.zh: 这一夜属于我，也属于你
lines.en: This night is mine, and yours
You actually touched me
A piece of my edge breaks away
This wound will take until next year
The moon did not shield me
I draw back, and the frost retreats

lines.zh: 这一下我记住了你的脸
lines.en: That blow made me remember your face
I feel no pain, only displeasure
My shape wavered
You are bolder than you look
We settle this next year
Is this the right one, I must look closely
Set it at my feet, do not hand it over
Wrong, try again
You still have time to choose again
I sniff it, not right

lines.zh: 正确的东西有秋天的味道
lines.en: The right thing smells of autumn
Withdraw your hand, I have seen enough

lines.zh: 多来一件，我就少一分怒气
lines.en: One more item, one less measure of my anger
You are guessing, I can tell
I do not eat, I only collect
You touched the cold of autumn
I shift back and the frost disperses
The moon saw that

lines.zh: 你的热气和我的冷撞在一起
lines.en: Your warmth met my cold
Do not lean on me, you will frost over
I passed through you, and came back
Bone on bone, brittle and dry
One step back, that was a warning
Your body temperature is dropping
I touched your forehead
I come only once a year

lines.zh: 另一个我，在别的月亮下
lines.en: Another of me is under another moon
When kin meet, we trade offerings

lines.zh: 我们不结伴，只在今夜相逢
lines.en: We do not pair, we only meet tonight

lines.zh: 两张脸并排，月亮也会躲
lines.en: Two faces side by side, even the moon hides

lines.zh: 我有我的田野，它有它的
lines.en: I have my fields, it has its own

lines.zh: 同样的霜，落到两个人身上
lines.en: The same frost falls on two of us

lines.zh: 这一夜有伴，田野会更冷
lines.en: With a companion tonight, the fields grow colder

lines.zh: 我们一起站着，谁都不说话
lines.en: We stand together and neither speaks

lines.zh: 明年这个时候，也许还会遇上
lines.en: Perhaps we meet again this time next year

lines.zh: 月光下的东西，我先闻一闻。
lines.en: I sniff the thing bathed in moonlight.
Does this count as the right offering
The offering is wrong; I set it down.
Not right, I put it back

lines.zh: 东西落在我掌上结了霜
lines.en: It frosts over in my palm
I raise it to the moon to inspect
I do not want this one
I have taken it, you may step back

lines.zh: 掉落的东西也是月亮的
lines.en: Fallen things belong to the moon too
I set it in the row
I turn my face to you
The offering is wrong, so it is you
The moon already gave you a chance
You chose wrong, I saw it
The hunt starts now

lines.zh: 满月的光，照出你的供品。
lines.en: Full-moon light shows your offering.
This game ends only at dawn
I am not fast, and you cannot shake me

lines.zh: 田野里没有藏身的地方
lines.en: There is nowhere to hide in open fields
Your house will not stop me
Wrong offering — then it is you.
I will walk this night out with you
That gap in the door is useless

lines.zh: 满月下，你的影子无处可藏。
lines.en: Under the full moon your shadow has nowhere to hide.
Do not count on the moon to speak for you
A wrong choice has its price
I follow, leaving frost with each step

lines.zh: 你跑过田埂，我走过田埂
lines.en: You cross the ridge, and so do I

lines.zh: 我的人脸已经在墙上了
lines.en: My faces are already on your walls
Do you hear those whispers
Locks do not stop shadows
I press my hand to your window
The night is long, I do not tire

lines.zh: 你每喘一口气，我就近一点
lines.en: With each breath you take, I come closer

lines.zh: 村子里的灯一盏盏灭了
lines.en: The village lamps go out one by one
Wherever you run, the moon is there

lines.zh: 我停下来，是因为你回头了
lines.en: I stop because you looked back
Everyone here is asleep

lines.zh: 你的脚印在霜里很清楚
lines.en: Your prints show clearly in the frost

lines.zh: 我不用追，我们总会遇上
lines.en: No need to chase, we will meet

lines.zh: 天快亮了，你运气好的话
lines.en: Dawn is near, if you are lucky

lines.zh: 我在你身前，也在你身后
lines.en: I am ahead of you and behind you

lines.zh: 那些脸会一直在你旁边
lines.en: Those faces will stay beside you
The more you run, the closer you come
This is my favorite part
The moon has not set yet

lines.zh: 我伸手，碰到了你的胸口
lines.en: I reach out and touch your chest
That takes your warmth away

lines.zh: 我的手指从你肩上滑过
lines.en: My fingers slide over your shoulder

lines.zh: 你身上结了薄薄一层霜
lines.en: A thin frost forms on you
The grab was light, the mark is deep
I pin you against the door
The cold slows your movements

lines.zh: 我的手穿进你的影子里
lines.en: My hand sinks into your shadow
You flinched, and I saw it
You will feel cold all night
I lean close to your ear
Your arm is going numb
This is not meant to kill you
I only want that one thing
The moon saw you fall
Hold on a little, dawn is coming
The moon has reached its height
I appear at the field's edge, with frost
The fields are bare, so I came
First the cold, then me
I step down out of the moonlight

lines.zh: 这一夜是我讨债的时候
lines.en: This is the night I collect
I stand at your gate
The dog in the house dares not bark
My shadow enters first
Did you hear the knock

lines.zh: 我把供品的位置记下了
lines.en: I have noted where the offering should go
Faces slowly surface on the walls

lines.zh: 月亮给了我一夜的时间
lines.en: The moon gave me one night
Frost spreads out from my feet
There is only one matter tonight
I begin at one end of the village
The wind stopped because I am here

lines.zh: 我来要那件早就该给的东西
lines.en: I come for what was long owed
Your lamp is still lit, very good
This night's name is mine
The red of fire is not the moon's
The frost shatters as I land
Water washes the moonlight off me
The blast's glare is painful

lines.zh: 飞来的东西穿过我的脸
lines.en: Something flying passed through my face

lines.zh: 这股力和我很像，我不喜欢
lines.en: This force resembles mine, and I dislike it
Not enough offerings, and my hunger grows
Lightning is brighter than moonlight, it hurts
There is no moon in the void
